recent.text: MacKenzie Weegar matched his career high with three assists today, joining Mikhail Sergachev (4x) and John Marino as the third Utah defenseman to post three assists in a single game. He also recorded two primary assists in a single period (1st) for the fifth time in his career.

recent.text: "He moved the puck well, he closed quickly. For a guy who was in his first game, and not a lot of practice because of the schedule lately, I think he did pretty good." -HC André Tourigny on Gregor Biber's performance in his NHL debut #TusksUp

recent.text: André Tourigny on winning 4 of the last 5 games: “We don’t want that to be an achievement. We want that to be a blueprint.” #TusksUp

recent.text: Selected ninth overall in the 2021 NHL Draft, Guenther became the eighth player from his draft class to reach the 100-assist mark. Among players from that draft class with at least 25 NHL games played, Guenther also ranks fourth in career assists per game (0.40).

recent.text: Lawson Crouse has scored in four straight road games (11/11-11/27: 4g, 1a), tying Logan Cooley (10/15/26-11/1/26: 7g, 2a) for the longest road goal streak in franchise history. Crouse's three-game goal streak (11/23-11/27: 3g) is also tied for the longest of his NHL career.
